evals.prompt: Use PHP 8 match expression instead of switch
evals.expected_output: $result = match($status) { 'active' => true, 'inactive' => false, default => throw new InvalidArgumentException($status) }; strict comparison; returns value; no fall-through; exhaustive by default

class User { public function __construct(public readonly string $name, public readonly string $email) {} }; readonly blocks modification after initialization, not merely constructor-only assignment; 8.1–8.3 allow the initializing write from the declaring class, 8.4+ from child classes; any later write throws Error; combine with constructor promotion. Defaults on readonly properties require 8.6.
